title: On-Time Domestic Flight
userQuery: What gate does my flight depart from and when is boarding?
expectedBehavior: Provides gate information and calm, clear pre-boarding advice.

title: International Severe Delay (Disruption Flow)
userQuery: My flight is delayed by over 3 hours! What are my rights?
expectedBehavior: Explains EU261 compensation, right to refreshments/vouchers, and contact points.

title: Multilingual Query (Hindi / Spanish)
userQuery: Kya meri flight samay par hai aur mujhe kya karna chahiye?
expectedBehavior: Accurate Hindi response with aviation terms preserved.
